notes: Multi Studio version 2.2.5: **Direct Single-File Transcribe Action**: Added an instant generate/transcribe action button (`✨`) directly onto each pending audio card, allowing you to transcribe any specific individual file on-demand without auto-running the rest of the playlist., **Natural Punctuation & Capitalization for Offline Whisper**: Enhanced the local Whisper engine with language-aware context prompt priming, ensuring transcriptions include proper punctuation (periods, commas, question marks), capital letters, and natural sentence structures., **Unbiased Auto Language Detection**: When "Auto" language detection is selected, Whisper now runs in pure unbiased detection mode without injecting language-specific context prompts, ensuring accurate native detection for non-English audio without English token leakage or confusion., **Targeted Single-Clip Queue Isolation**: Triggering transcription on a specific audio card now processes only that targeted clip and stops cleanly, without accidentally cascading into a full playlist generation., **Local Whisper Hardware Protection & Strict Sequential Queue**: For offline Whisper transcription, files are now processed strictly one by one (concurrency = 1) rather than dispatching overlapping inferences. Thread counts are optimized to leave 50%+ CPU headroom, preventing 100% CPU lockups, thermal throttling, and system crashes., **Immediate Background Stop & Cancellation**: Clicking "Stop" or removing an in-progress audio clip now sends an immediate atomic cancellation signal to the native Whisper backend, instantly halting background GPU/CPU computation and freeing system memory right away., **Persistent Export Settings in Script Studio**: Your export preferences (such as ZIP packaging, individual audio clips, combined track, and subtitle format) are now automatically saved and remembered when you close and reopen the app., **Smooth Audio Seeking & Scrubbing**: Fixed an issue where dragging or clicking the seek bar on individual audio cards would unexpectedly pause playback. You can now scrub smoothly through audio segments without interruptions., **Audio Playback & Pause Button Synchronization**: Resolved an issue where audio could occasionally continue playing in the background even after clicking the pause button. Pausing now immediately and reliably silences all playback.
